params.body:
Closes #985

## Problem

Nightwatch #60: `UnableToCheckFileExistence` at `app/Jobs/ProcessImage.php:174`. This is the HEAD on the original before a platform copy is made. Flysystem throws it when the bucket does not answer, not when the file is missing. The bucket has been intermittently slow since 4 October, and `App\Support\StorageUnavailable::retryOnce()` was added for that. The sweepers and `ProcessVehiclePhoto` use it; `ProcessImage` did not. One slow HEAD ended the attempt with an unhandled exception, and the queue retried at once because the job has no backoff.

## Change

- Every bucket question in `dupliceer()` goes through `StorageUnavailable::retryOnce()`: the source check, the free-name search, the check after the copy and the thumbnail check. That last one was asked inside the row update; it now runs just before the update.
- When the bucket still does not answer, `handle()` logs a warning and releases the job for `SLOW_BUCKET_DELAY` (60 s). The row is not touched, and no "source missing" note goes on the tile: a slow bucket is not a missing original. The release happens before anything external runs (remove.bg and Blurit come after the copy), so a retry never pays twice. When the attempts run out, `failed()` stops the spinner and notes the reason, as before.
- The catch is limited to the copy step on purpose. Releasing after remove.bg has run would buy a second cut-out.

One edge case remains. If the HEAD *after* a successful copy fails twice, the retry makes a new copy under the next free name, and the first copy stays in the bucket with no row pointing at it. Nothing shows it, so it costs storage only.

## Tests

Two new tests in `ASlowBucketIsNotAMissingPhotoTest`. Both fail on main with the exact Nightwatch exception:
- one slow HEAD on the original: the copy is made, nothing is released, and no reason is noted;
- a bucket that never answers: the job is released with 60 s, the row is unchanged, `processing` stays 1, and no reason is noted.

Full suite locally: 3042 tests, OK (2 skipped, 1 incomplete, as on main). PHPStan: no errors.

Source: Portal mail:11.
params.title: ProcessImage: retry a slow bucket HEAD before the platform copy, release instead of crashing
